description:
Throw in a situation and it’ll surface items for you—like “tomorrow’s date outfit,” “work slacks,” “a winter puffer that’s actually warm,” or “comfy sneakers.”
When something catches your eye, it pulls up the reviews right away and summarizes the key bits—“Does it run small or big?”, “Is the fabric sturdy?”, “How’s the fit?”—so comparing options is easy.
Less scrolling, faster picks.
